examFacts.answer: The Italian theory test for a category B car licence (esame di teoria, quiz patente B) is taken on a computer at the Motorizzazione civile, or at a driving school with approved rooms: 30 statements, each marked true or false (vero o falso), in 20 minutes, and you pass with no more than 3 errors. It must be passed within six months of the licence application, with at most two attempts and at least a month between them; a pass brings the learner permit (foglio rosa), valid for twelve months, for the practical test.
